frames.rs routes bench-make to make and bench arguments to bench. sample reads course explain then facts; make writes row IDs and lossy whitespace, load_items/load_gold bind by IDs, system reads lessons from start, bench aggregates score_line and show_g displays diagnostics. Native tests execute parse_gold -> score_line -> overall and parse_frame -> show_g -> parse_frame; live joins are inspected only.
inverse: Within pure fixtures, selected IDs retain input order; frame display preserves the parsed observation on the tested canonical notation domain. Filesystem, lesson identity and live reader correctness are external obligations.
